sources.title: The Atlantic Telegraph (1865)
sources.author: William Howard Russell
sources.edition: Project Gutenberg no. 40948; transcription of a Naval Institute Press reprint of the 1865 work. The reprint front matter is retained in the raw HTML.
sources.role: Eyewitness narrative for the 1865 voyage; retrospective account of 1854–1858; includes company and technical documents.
sources.transformation: scripts/book_sources.py extracts text from printed page 1 onward, preserving printed-page markers and collapsing whitespace. Image captions are retained, images are not included.
sources.rights: Historical work is public domain in the United States; digital-provider notices remain in retained raw inputs where present.

sources.title: The Atlantic Telegraph: Report of the Proceedings at a Banquet Given to Mr. Cyrus W. Field
sources.author: Chamber of Commerce of New-York; speech by Cyrus W. Field
sources.edition: New York: John W. Amerman, printer. Banquet at the Metropolitan Hotel, 15 November 1866. Internet Archive scan and OCR.
sources.role: Participant speech after the successful expeditions. Celebration and self-justification are part of the source; it is not an independent engineering audit.
sources.transformation: scripts/book_sources.py collapses whitespace in the retained OCR. OCR spelling and split words are not silently corrected; compare the retained PDF, printed page N = PDF page N+6 for the speech (e.g. p.30 = PDF page36).
sources.rights: Historical work is public domain in the United States; digital-provider notices remain in retained raw inputs where present.

sources.title: History of the Atlantic Telegraph, selected passage
sources.author: Henry M. Field
sources.edition: 1866 volume, printed p.361; Internet Archive / Google scan. Only the cited page is retained as a PDF shard.
sources.role: Contemporary history by Cyrus Field’s brother, reproducing Cyrus’s landing telegram. This is a mediated report, not the original telegram or an independent witness.
sources.transformation: Manual transcription of the final paragraph on p.361; line-end hyphens joined, quotation marks and dash spacing normalized. Ends at the page boundary. Facsimile shard made with PyMuPDF 1.26.5: source PDF page index363, zero-based.
sources.rights: Historical work is public domain in the United States; digital-provider notices remain in retained raw inputs where present.

downloaded_original.retention: Selected page retained; complete download not required for offline builds.

sources.title: The Times and General Commercial Gazette: Telegrams and Postscript
sources.author: The Times and General Commercial Gazette (St. John’s, Newfoundland)
sources.edition: Memorial University Digital Archives Initiative scan; scan page3, second full column. Items dated Heart’s Content, July29 and July31.
sources.role: Local newspaper publication close to the event; the Postscript is attributed to Cyrus Field and is not independent authorship of his telegram.
sources.transformation: Manual selected-item transcription, not full OCR. Line-end hyphens joined, quotation marks/dash spacing normalized; italic emphasis omitted. Facsimile shard made with PyMuPDF 1.26.5: source PDF page index2, zero-based.
sources.rights: Historical work is public domain in the United States; digital-provider notices remain in retained raw inputs where present.
